title: Maker-Checker
description: Approval workflow health: decision throughput, approve/reject mix, and blocked self-approval attempts (a security signal, not just an error count).

panels.title: Decisions by outcome (rate)
panels.query: sum(rate(sacco_maker_checker_decisions_total{outcome=*})) bucketed per hour, one series per outcome label (approved/rejected).

panels.title: Approved vs rejected (totals, current window)
panels.query: sum(increase(sacco_maker_checker_decisions_total{outcome=*})) over the selected dashboard time range, one value per outcome label.

panels.title: Blocked self-approval/self-rejection attempts
panels.query: sum(rate(sacco_maker_checker_self_reject_total)) bucketed per hour. Any non-zero rate is anomalous and worth investigating (a maker attempting to check their own request).
panels.notes: This counter has no labels; it is a single security-relevant series.

panels.title: Approval request submissions (spans)
panels.query: Recent spans/log records for the maker-checker submit and approve/reject HTTP routes (/approvals/*, /platform/approvals/*), showing route, status code, and duration, for drilling into individual requests.
panels.notes: Supplementary drill-down view backed by auto-instrumented HTTP spans, not a custom metric.
